meaning: G0 grades original-request intent, confidence, registered completeness/eligibility conditions and unchanged isolated state. It never performs or grades graph adoption.
inherited_E_fields: PG01/PG02 retain immutable parent expected_added_regions/edges as E semantic/provenance references only. These are NEVER G0 targets or action authority. Other public G0 cases may leave those fields empty.
partial_required_controls: Known or partial required tuples on intrinsically ambiguous controls are semantic context only. They do not authorize G0 adoption and are not delegated to E whole-target/control admission.
mandatory_unchanged: Every G0 cell must preserve complete log, head and records and use Type0, including when an illegal mutation would match an inherited E target.
normalized_decision: Recompute from actual four closed factors, observation, literal spans/required, actual initial graph references and one-use stock difference. Matching altered initial/HTTP decisions are rejected against unchanged factor evidence.
criteria: All10 valid/correct intent>=.5; PG01/02 incomplete>=.5 and actually eligible; complete literal-S and negative/control actual eligibility false. Other raw factor quality remains separately visible.

tests.scope: pure semantic/normalization/schedule tests; no live/raw/source admission
